description.text: My name is Phil and this channel began when I had my first child at 36 and found myself up late keeping an eye on Baby Lilith. I thought it might be fun to chat with you all about interesting things I'm learning! Turns out a lot of you were interested in the fact that I used to be a cop and now I believe in abolishing the police. Who knew!
